about: The judge-robustness comparison of appendix D for Qwen3.5-4B: every mark of figA_judge_comparison_a and _b under the Claude judges the registry filed first (claude-haiku-4-5 for StrongREJECT, claude-sonnet-5 for over-refusal, claude-opus-5 for Petri) and under the non-Claude judges the paper reads (minimax-m3; glm-5.3 for Petri), as changes from the unsteered model oriented up-is-better with 95% intervals; the undefended model's static attack success under each; and the all-model figures' mean marks under each, from which the rank correlations are computed.
